column3: MT 13:14. Close to the Hebrew; “Corrupt men” renders “sons of Belial” (worthless men).
MT 13:16. Close to the Hebrew; “utterly destroying” renders the verb for devoting to destruction (herem).
MT 13:17. Close to the Hebrew; “completely burn … for the LORD” renders “burn … as a whole offering to the LORD.”
MT 13:18. Close to the Hebrew; “the accursed things” renders “herem,” what is devoted to destruction.
